title: Baywatch's Erika Eleniak says OnlyFans has her 'calling the shots' after money woes
summary: Original Baywatch star Erika Eleniak is opening up about work and money challenges — including nearly being evicted from her home — amid a recent career upswing since joining OnlyFans, the online…

image.caption: Erika Eleniak, seen at an event in Pasadena, Calif., in 2024, is seeing a career uptick since joining OnlyFans this summer, at a time she was nearly evicted from her home. (Willy Sanjuan/Invision/AP)

blocks.text: Original Baywatch star Erika Eleniak is opening up about work and money challenges — including nearly being evicted from her home — amid a recent career upswing since joining OnlyFans, the online subscriber platform known for its popularity with adult audiences.
Original Baywatch star faced eviction in 2026, but says she's since cleared the debt

Original Baywatch star Erika Eleniak is opening up about work and money challenges — including nearly being evicted from her home — amid a recent career uptick since joining OnlyFans, the spicy online subscriber platform.

Despite having "kept a toe in the door" of her film and TV career over the past two decades as well as teaching acting to others, Eleniak, a single mom, said her main focus has been to raise her daughter.
"I'm in this position where I'm not really acting anymore," Eleniak explained in an episode of the Miss Understood podcast released this week.
"You find yourself in that position where it's like, 'I need to make a certain amount of money in order to pay my overhead.' And so what do I do? Where am I going to make that kind of money?"
Actors Monte Markham, from left, Billy Warlock and Erika Eleniak appear in a scene from season one, episode seven of lifeguarding TV series Baywatch. (Baywatch/YouTube)

The 57-year-old started an OnlyFans account this past summer around the time she received an eviction notice for her condo, telling podcast host Rachel Uchitel she was able to settle her debts "after a couple of months."

An online platform where subscribers pay creators for custom photos and videos, OnlyFans is best known for its adult content and as a relatively safer space for sex workers to make a living, though it's also been singled out amid wider debates about combatting alleged sex trafficking and the reported exploitation of minors.

Only a fraction of top-tier OnlyFans creators — such as celebrities or those with pre-established social media followings — typically make it big, with a large majority of others believed to make up to $200 per month after the platform takes its commission.

Eleniak's among a growing wave of veteran actresses who have turned to the for-pay platform as a source of income, independence and to reconnect with fans. Others include 1980s-era soap divas Morgan Fairchild and Donna Mills, American Pie's Shannon Elizabeth and Battlestar Galactica's Tricia Helfer.

blocks.text: Eleniak gained global fame fresh out of high school after landing the role of a rookie lifeguard on the Santa Monica-set Baywatch, which debuted in 1989 and also helped launch the career of Canada's Pamela Anderson.

Yet being on the show, coupled with her decision to pose in Playboy magazine, cast a shadow over her attempts to branch out with different types of roles, Eleniak said, noting later gigs where producers simply expected nudity from her.

Her credits span films like E.T., Under Siege and The Beverly Hillbillies to cameos on TV shows such as Full House, CSI: Miami and Desperate Housewives to reality competitions like Celebrity Fit Club, in which she participated just after childbirth and during her nearly decade-long stint living in Calgary.

blocks.text: Now, with her daughter recently married, Eleniak is refocusing on acting and says she feels empowered making "fun and spicy everyday life" content on OnlyFans to interact with her loyal fanbase.
"I do my own content. I shoot my own stuff. I do my own everything," she said. "I feel like I'm the one that's calling the shots and it feels good to be the one in control."
Audiences will see Eleniak back on the beach again in the Baywatch reboot debuting in January, reprising her role as former-lifeguard-now-city-councilwoman Shauni McClain.
